name: Summerfun at The Common School
description_short: Six week summer camp at The Common School in Amherst. Young children explore Bramble Hill Farm and the Larch Hill conservation land, while campers 8 and up choose weekly specialty camps such as STEAM, clay, art and tabletop games.
refund_policy_summary: A $100 non refundable deposit per session holds a place; withdrawals 30 days or more before camp get a refund minus the deposit, and later payments are non refundable except for medical emergencies.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Limited financial aid, applications due 2/15. The subtitle says ages 3 to 14 and the header says 3 to 13, so age_max is left out. The individual camp listings below still show dates such as 6/22 through 7/31 that fit 2026, not 2027, so no sessions are recorded.
